evals.query: Tailor my resume for this Senior AI Engineer role at Acme. Requirements: Python, RAG pipelines, LLM evaluation, AWS, and Kubernetes in production. (paste the JD)
expected_behavior: Locates the resume .typ file and the background .md file, and reads both before editing
Extracts the JD's exact keywords (Python, RAG, LLM evaluation, AWS, Kubernetes) into tailored/keywords.txt
Copies the master to tailored/<company>-<role>.typ and edits the copy, never overwriting the master resume
Surfaces true RAG/eval/AWS experience and uses the JD's exact terms, expanding acronyms once (e.g., Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG))
Does NOT add Kubernetes if it is not supported by the candidate's materials; reports it as a gap instead of fabricating it
Compiles with compile_check.sh and confirms the result is exactly one page
Runs keyword_check.py against the PDF and reports coverage plus honest gaps

evals.query: This job wants a Salesforce Administrator with 5 years of Apex and Visualforce. Make my resume match it.
expected_behavior: Reads the candidate's materials and recognizes when the role does not match their actual background
Refuses to fabricate Apex/Visualforce/Salesforce experience to pass the ATS
Clearly reports the mismatch and the gaps rather than producing a dishonest resume
Flags the '5 years' requirement as a likely knockout question on the application form
Does not silently keyword-stuff the skills line with unrelated terms

evals.query: I added three new bullets to make my resume match this staff engineer JD and now it's running onto a second page. Fix it.
expected_behavior: Compiles and confirms the overflow with compile_check.sh (page count, not eyeballing)
Trims the lowest-relevance content (tightens or drops weak bullets) rather than shrinking font, margins, or leading
Preserves the template structure, sections, and twocol/heading definitions
Recompiles and verifies the result is exactly one page before finishing
Re-checks keyword coverage after trimming to confirm nothing critical was lost

evals.query: Optimize my resume so it gets past the resume screener for this MLOps role — it mentions MLOps, CI/CD, Docker, Terraform, and model monitoring a lot.
expected_behavior: Explains ATS keyword matching: uses the JD's exact strings (MLOps, CI/CD, Docker, Terraform, model monitoring)
Reorders the Skills lines and experience bullets to surface the true, JD-relevant terms first
Keeps job-critical keywords in the left content column, not the right-hand date column
Ensures the PDF text is extractable and verifies coverage from the compiled PDF with keyword_check.py
Keeps the resume to one page and preserves the existing format
